resources.string: Marks movies and episodes you watch in the player as watched on Trakt, a free tracker. Titles opened from Movies, TV or Anime.
Disconnect Trakt?
AnantPlay stops telling Trakt what you watch. Your Trakt history stays.
Connect Trakt
Can\'t reach Trakt. Check WARP and try again.
Trakt connected
The code ran out. Close this and press Trakt again for a new one.
Trakt turned this down. Close this and try again.
Marked watched on Trakt
Sets your progress on AniList when you watch an anime episode in the player. Titles opened from Anime. You sign in on AniList\'s own page.
Disconnect AniList?
AnantPlay stops updating AniList. Your list stays.
AniList connected
AniList progress updated
Sets your progress on MyAnimeList when you watch an anime episode in the player. Titles opened from Anime. You sign in on MyAnimeList\'s own page.
Disconnect MyAnimeList?
AnantPlay stops updating MyAnimeList. Your list stays.
MyAnimeList connected
MyAnimeList progress updated
